author: British Museum
title: British Museum catalogue record for photograph Oc-A35-53

notes.text: This British Museum catalogue record describes a September 1980 photograph by Katesa Schlosser. It is registered as a documentary source, not as a physical Rapa Nui artefact. The 30 September 2026 image-rights review found that the museum's image page explicitly says the image is unavailable for download and supplies no reusable image licence or credit, so no image is published. The complete Description field identifies Ahu Vai Uri and the photographed view; the curator's contextual comment is collapsed in the live record and was not extracted. The former site-targeted extraction is retained here after correcting the collection boundary: “Photograph (colour); view of Ahu Vai Uri (ceremonial platform) with five moai (figure carving); the sea on the right of the image, and the fishing village of Hanga Roa in the background; Tahai, Easter Island.” (Description) The site is not a collection object because its displacement is not under investigation.
